# Global flags

Accepted before or after any subcommand.

- `--endpoint <ENDPOINT>`: Cluster endpoint. Falls back to TRITONCTL_ENDPOINT, then config
- `--api-key <API_KEY>`: API-key bearer. Falls back to TRITONCTL_API_KEY
- `--project <PROJECT>`: Project to work in (name, uuid, or uuid prefix). The tenant is inferred from your token. Defaults to `configure --project`
- `-p, --profile <PROFILE>`: The profile to use for this command (`profile ls` lists them). Defaults to TRITONCTL_PROFILE, then `profile use`
- `--timeout <SECS>`: Give up on a request after this many seconds. 0 waits forever (default: 60)
- `-v, --verbose`: On error, print the full cause chain for a bug report
- `-j, --json`: Emit JSON instead of a table. Same as `--format json`
- `--format <FORMAT>`: Output format. `-j` is shorthand for `--format json` (one of: table, json, yaml)
- `-o, --output <COLS>`: Columns to show, comma separated. A dotted path such as `sysinfo.hostname` reads a field of the raw record. Table only
- `-l, --long`: Show the resource's wider column set. Ignored with `-o`
- `-s, --sort <COLS>`: Sort by these columns, comma separated. A leading `-` reverses that column. Applies to tables and JSON alike
- `-H, --no-headers`: Omit the header row
- `--limit <N>`: Stop after this many rows
